findings.summary: Reuse atomic writeJsonRecord for reports and receipts.
Reuse shared assignment, update, property-name and source-location helpers.
Share fingerprint construction for ordinary and merged declarations.
Format usage types and locations only after an API target matches.
Reuse the shared pinned source store in inventory and compilation.
Index cases by target and receipts by case ID.
Precompute report search text and case lookup maps.
Separate baseline validation into typed readers and consolidate identifier handling.
Journal reached nodes using EmissionWeakSet and emissionArray.
Cache declaration kinds and reuse contentDigest for file hashes.
Stream trace files during baseline consolidation.
Use scoped observers instead of excluding test filenames.
Resolve option provenance with the TypeScript checker instead of duplicating source evaluation.
Prepare translation metadata lazily when observation is enabled.
Deduplicate translation events before hashing pinned source text.
Record actual adapter dispatches at the shared numeric translator.
Recover translated source owners from visited original nodes using ts.findAncestor.
